method: 500 m cumulative 8-day MODIS GPP and net photosynthesis; scale factor 0.0001 kg C m-2; MODLAND QC bit 0 = good; valid-range values only; pixel-center RFO mask in equal-area MODIS sinusoidal grid. Composite totals are apportioned by overlap days at a uniform daily rate. Valid-pixel sums are not spatially expanded; area-expanded values divide each composite sum by its valid-area fraction and remain model estimates, not net ecosystem sequestration or emissions.
